en: Shihab al-Din Abu al-Fadl Ahmad ibn Ali ibn Hajar al-Asqalani
tr: Şihâbeddin Ebü'l-Fazl Ahmed b. Ali İbn Hacer el-Askalânî
ar: شهاب الدين أبو الفضل أحمد بن علي ابن حجر العسقلاني

description.tr: Sahîh-i Buhârî'nin kesin şerhini (Fethu'l-Bârî) yazdı — en muteber hadis koleksiyonunun en muteber açıklaması. 13 cilt, 25 yıllık çalışma || İbn Hacer, Memlük döneminin en büyük hadis alimiydi. || [Tarih notu] Fethu'l-Bârî'nin 1428'deki tamamlanması Kahire'de Memlük sultanının finanse ettiği kamusal bir şölenle kutlandı.
description.en: Wrote the definitive commentary on Sahih al-Bukhari (Fath al-Bari) — the most authoritative explanation of the most authoritative hadith collection. 13 volumes, 25 years of work || Ibn Hajar was the greatest hadith scholar of the Mamluk era. His Fath al-Bari took 25 years to write and is considered the definitive explanation of Bukhari's collection. Source material mentions him alongside Maqrizi and Suyuti as the intellectual pillars of Mamluk Cairo. || [Historiographical note] Fath al-Bari's completion in 1428 was celebrated in Cairo with a public feast funded by the Mamluk sultan — one of the few occasions a book launch was a state event.
description.ar: كتب الشرح الحاسم لصحيح البخاري (فتح الباري) — أوثق شرح لأوثق مجموعة حديث. ١٣ مجلدًا في ٢٥ عامًا || كان ابن حجر أعظم محدّث في العصر المملوكي. استغرق فتح الباري ٢٥ عامًا ويُعدّ الشرح الحاسم لصحيح البخاري
